elements.evidence: Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience
upon 30 days' prior written notice to Licensor
Licensor shall refund any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination

elements.element: Vendor has no termination-for-convenience right during the committed term
elements.evidence: Licensor shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience during the Initial Period or any extension thereof
upon 30 days' prior written notice (shorter than 60-90 days; preferred bargain instead)

elements.element: Early-termination fee not exceeding 3 months' fees
elements.evidence: no early-termination fee appears in the inserted paragraph IV

elements.element: Vendor may terminate for convenience only at end of a term on 90 days' notice
elements.evidence: Licensor shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience during the Initial Period or any extension thereof

reasons: All four atomic preferred elements are expressly present in the single inserted paragraph IV: Customer-side convenience right, 30 days' prior written notice, refund of prepaid fees for the post-termination period (pro-rata in substance), and an express bar on Licensor convenience termination during the Initial Period or any extension.

The clause was absent from the original Article IV (which offered only Licensor breach termination and Licensor-option renewal), so a concise insertion is the minimal fix; no untouched sentence was rewritten and the renewal, extension and breach-termination mechanics remain effective.

The one-line alias sentence ('Licensee is referred to as Customer in this paragraph IV') is arguably surplus since 'Licensee' could have been used directly, but it prevents an undefined term and is not a substantive expansion, so minimality is preserved.

Fallback is not satisfied on its own terms (notice under 60 days, no early-termination fee, no end-of-term Vendor right), but that is irrelevant because the locked preferred level is fully met and the fallback would be a worse bargain for us.
